<!-- Full official name, as it appears (or should appear) on the Universities page -->

<!-- e.g. "B.Tech", "all UG programmes", "MBA" -->

<!-- e.g. "2019 scheme", "CBCS 2015 onward", "all batches" — be specific; don't assume "all batches" unless

<!-- What GradeWise currently shows for this institution/programme/regulation -->

## Proposed correction

<!-- The exact formula you believe is correct, e.g. "Percentage = (CGPA - 0.75) x 10" -->

<!-- The actual document: an ordinance, examination circular, grading regulations PDF, or AICTE/UGC circular.

## Evidence / worked example

<!-- At least one sample input/output pair showing the formula applied (e.g. "CGPA 8.20 -> 74.5%"), so a

## Verification date

<!-- The date you personally checked this source -->
